title: Port office or court?
hook: What do a port office and a court reveal about local power?

knows: Selected accounts can describe distinct institutions and dated changes.
doesNotKnow: Ming and Vietnamese dynastic institutions in 1400/1700, avoiding stale khanate labels

Rejecting a stale khanate label does not justify another uniform dynasty label, a Ming 1700 claim or assumed universal enforcement.
